evidence_role: Simulation only. Says which experiment to run; says nothing about how biochar behaves.
question: For a fixed number of reactors, which choice of number of doses, replicates per dose, highest dose and dose spacing gives the highest worst-case probability that a whole-dose-held-out test selects the true dose-response form of methane potential, when the location of any optimum is unknown?

surrogate.description: Two-stage surrogate of the Stage A rule. Each reactor's methane potential is drawn as ln P = f(x) + e, x = ln(1 + dose in g/L), e ~ Normal(0, sd). Candidate forms constant, linear and quadratic in x are fitted by ordinary least squares to the reactor values of all doses but one and scored by RMSE of ln P over the replicates of the held-out dose; scores are averaged over doses with equal weight. The simplest form is kept unless a more complex one lowers that mean by more than 10% (the stage_a_dose_v1 parsimony margin).
surrogate.why: The trajectory-level Stage A simulation takes about 15 s per run on the development machine, too slow for a design search. The surrogate ignores curve-fitting error and the rate parameter.
surrogate.agreement_check: For the four designs in results/stage-a-power, report surrogate and trajectory-level share correct side by side at sd 0.03 and 0.07, gain 0.15, optimum at 8 g/L. No threshold; the comparison is reported as is.

design_space.replicates: the largest integer r >= 2 with doses * r <= budget

spacing.log: doses evenly spaced in ln(1 + d) from 0 to ln(1 + highest dose)
spacing.linear: doses evenly spaced in d from 0 to highest dose

truths.monotone: ln P = ln P0 + ln(1 + gain) * x / ln(9), i.e. the stated gain at 8 g/L
truths.optimum_5: quadratic in x with its maximum ln(1 + gain) above baseline at 5 g/L

correct_selection: constant for the constant truth, linear for the monotone truth, quadratic for every optimum truth
primary_objective: For each budget, gain and sd: the design with the highest minimum share correct over the six truths (maximin).
secondary: Share correct for every truth and design
False curvature: share selecting quadratic under the constant or monotone truth
Smallest budget at which the maximin design reaches 0.80, per gain and sd, if any
reporting: All designs and scenarios are written to the results table. No design, truth, threshold or count is changed after the first run.
